recovery.title: Default project needs recovery
recovery.description: The default project's record is missing. Existing conversation files may still be present. Restore the record to continue using the app.
recovery.deferredDescription: No project data was changed. You can restore later using the button below, or ask an administrator to recover the original record from a backup.
recovery.confirmDescription: A backup will be created first. The project name, workspace path, instructions and memory settings will reset to defaults. Existing conversations, workspace files and global settings will be kept. Other services sharing this data directory should be stopped before continuing.
recovery.successDescription: The service is ready. Existing conversations remain available; review the default project's settings after recovery.
recovery.networkError: The recovery result could not be confirmed. Check your connection and refresh this page before retrying.
recovery.backup_failed: The backup could not be completed, so recovery did not proceed. Ask an administrator to check disk space and permissions, then retry.
recovery.repair_failed: Recovery could not be completed. Existing files were not automatically replaced. Ask an administrator to check the server log before retrying.
recovery.startup_failed: The project record is available, but another startup step failed. Normal operations remain paused. Ask an administrator to check the server log, then retry.

team.title: Agent Team
team.subtitle: Dispatch · Observe · Control (Host Bridge)
team.connectHint: One Bridge per computer. A server started with --dev also offers a local debug command. Without --dev, only the remote command is shown.
team.localDebugHint: Run it on this computer. --dev uses your checkout (MS_AGENT_ROOT, or a parent of the current directory) and your own node. The API is 127.0.0.1.
team.remoteConnectHint: Run it on the computer you want to attach, without --dev. That computer needs ms-agent installed.
team.afterConnect: After the daemon is up, Bridges below turn online; enable more Agents as needed.
team.noBridges: No Bridge yet. Generate a connect command and run it on the computer you want to attach.
team.noAgentsOnBridge: No Agents yet — enable a candidate below or add one
team.cloudDemoHint: Register a cloud Agent for dispatch without a local Bridge.
team.placeholder: No @ sends to Lead to decompose. @name dispatches that worker.
team.hintStart: Create a Team project (default Lead is an online cloud agent, not @me) → send without @ so Lead decomposes
team.leadHint: Messages without @ go to this Lead. Do not pick @me — that routes to the local worker, not decompose.
team.emptyBoard: Board is empty. Send to Lead to decompose.
team.noDispatch: No dispatches — is an online Agent registered?
team.needProject: Create or select a project first
team.replyOnRailHint: Answer this worker directly (not via Lead). Use this to fill in a path or scope.
team.replyOnRailPlaceholder: e.g. Read /Users/…/Agent_Team_编排台_功能与架构.md
team.attributionMismatch: This stream does not belong to this card
team.noTasks: No tasks yet. Ask Lead to write subtasks with task_board_write, or @dispatch.
team.noWorkerRails: After dispatch starts, Lead and each worker keep a rail here — they stay after the run ends.
team.askLeadHint: Hand this question to Lead to patch the task.
team.planGateHint: Worker posts a read-only plan first; you approve before any code change. Off by default.
team.circuitOpen: Circuit open: too many failures for this fingerprint. Other rails are unaffected.
team.noDispatchYet: Not started yet — change assignee or deps, then it can dispatch
team.cannotAttach: This agent cannot continue an existing session. Use a new session.
team.offlineTarget: That agent is offline or needs sign-in
